purpose: Adapters for strict nineteenth-century global slide collections recovered through the next deep-search census, with emphasis on named cabinets, diatom networks, institutional batches, historical transfers and current digital catalogues.
guards: Do not project mixed nineteenth/twentieth-century totals wholly into the nineteenth century; isolate pre-1900 records from dates, labels, makers or bounded set chronology.
Preserve collection attribution, preparation, use, purchase, bequest, donation and later institutional transfer as separate relationship claims.
Do not equate digital image counts, catalogue-number ranges or accession suffix ranges with physical slide counts unless the source explicitly establishes that equivalence.
Replicated exsiccata serial numbers identify corresponding set positions across institutions; never sum shared serial-number schemes as unique historical types without a copy-level question.

adapters.institution_scope: Natural History Museum of Denmark / University of Copenhagen Danish desmid collections
adapters.target: dedicated digitised Jacobsen Hoff and Børgesen desmid collection portal
adapters.promotion_rule: Enumerate the digitised slide records while preserving collector and publication relationships; keep the present 510 combined count distinct from per-collector subtotals.

adapters.institution_scope: Hungarian Natural History Museum Pantocsek diatom collection
adapters.target: official Algae Collection page plus continuous BP-HNHM-ALG-D catalogue and the 2025 collection study
adapters.promotion_rule: Retain the official 918-preparation statement and the 2025 1049-slide catalogue statement as an unresolved count-scope conflict; capture 1917 purchase, wartime loss and restoration as separate events.

adapters.institution_scope: Charles University Prague historical German University algal permanent-slide collection
adapters.target: CAUP image database and permanent-slide lists by taxon and locality
adapters.promotion_rule: Use maker, locality, label and date evidence to isolate pre-1900 physical slides; do not treat 1710 digital images or 1129 database specimens as a direct slide count.

adapters.institution_scope: Ohio State University Museum of Biological Diversity Herbarium diatom slide collection
adapters.target: official collection page and collector-organized cabinet metadata
adapters.promotion_rule: Treat 6700 as the current mixed-period aggregate and recover nineteenth-century subsets through named collectors, slide labels, cabinet structure and distributed-set chronology.

adapters.institution_scope: Smithsonian National Museum of American History Mary Ann Booth slide batch
adapters.target: NMAH object record, IIIF manifest and images for nmah_1837093
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture all nine labelled slides and IIIF metadata; retain pre-1898 Longmeadow dating as external specialist label chronology rather than an official Smithsonian date.

adapters.institution_scope: Springfield Science Museum Mary Ann Booth mounted-slide and photomicrograph archive
adapters.target: peer-reviewed Booth collection history and museum/archive endpoint discovery
adapters.promotion_rule: Use the scholarly bequest statement to locate a current archive inventory; keep photomicrographs separate from physical microscope slides and the 1922 bequest separate from nineteenth-century production.

adapters.institution_scope: Academy of Natural Sciences of Drexel University Diatom Herbarium
adapters.target: ANSP Symbiota Diatom Portal collection hierarchy and item records
adapters.promotion_rule: Harvest collection hierarchy, slide/set numbers, labels, localities and provenance. Preserve H.L. Smith's original working collection separately from distributed exsiccatae, and preserve ANSP copies of published sets as copy-level holdings.

adapters.institution_scope: Meise Botanic Garden Henri Van Heurck diatom collection
adapters.target: Antwerp institutional heritage history, current Meise research references, catalogue-card and type-slide discovery
adapters.promotion_rule: Model private assembly, 1910 municipal purchase/division and later botanical transfer to Meise separately; retain the >19000 figure as a dated 2007 collection statement until a current inventory is recovered.

adapters.institution_scope: Natural History Museum London Diatom Collection
adapters.target: official diatom collection page plus NHM Data Portal microscope-preparation records
adapters.promotion_rule: Filter Data Portal records by preparation kind, collection date, collector and named historical set to calculate any pre-1900 subset; never use the 300000 all-material total as a slide count.

adapters.institution_scope: Powerhouse Museum Technological Museum botanical research slide batch
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve the approximately 466-slide batch as a bounded 1880-1920 state and isolate pre-1900 slides only where labels, internal lists or item dates permit.

adapters.institution_scope: Canterbury Museum William Henry Symes microscope-slide box
adapters.target: University of Canterbury collection story and Canterbury Museum accession 2003.96.1, 41-62
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture the box, slide records and descendant-to-museum custody chain if catalogue access is found; do not convert accession suffixes 41-62 into a slide count without item records.

adapters.institution_scope: San Diego Natural History Museum Research Library Hartshorn-Bolles Microscope Slide Collection
adapters.target: OAC finding aid LA.2020.0306 and selected digital items
adapters.promotion_rule: Harvest cabinet/drawer hierarchy, selected item labels and preparer/retailer names; retain Bolles teaching use, transfer to Hartshorn and 1963 museum donation as distinct provenance events.
